description: Early-close one initiative in a program with completed-elsewhere, wont-do, duplicate, or superseded. Call action=preview first, present the returned impact, then call action=execute with only the proposalToken. The operation yields CLOSED, cancels active crews, and drops outstanding work items.

proposalToken.description: Required for execute; returned by preview.
